record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare ICE_HAMMER: Crabominable (2 stars) and Crabrawler (1 star); both also declare the BERRY_EATER passive, which is not covered here. The strategy is shared; differences are star count and stats. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Single target, three steps in this order: (1) request a 3000 ms freeze on the cast target; (2) request a 3000 ms paralysis on the CASTER itself (a drawback: the caster's attack cooldown speed is halved while paralysed); (3) deal SPECIAL damage to the target (raw 50 at 1 star, 100 at 2 stars; 200 / 400 for 3 / 4 stars exist in the table). The freeze is a request subject to Status.triggerFreeze guards and duration changes; the paralysis likewise to Status.triggerParalysis; neither duration scales with AP or crit. The damage is not conditioned on either status having been applied; it is dealt after them (so the target is already frozen when the damage lands if the freeze was applied).

targeting.who: the cast target (freeze and damage) and the caster itself (paralysis)
targeting.note: No area. The target is chosen by the generic cast pipeline (not traced here).

geometry.shape: single target plus self; no displacement

effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1]. handleSpecialDamage then: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost is passed explicitly as true, same as the default); x2 once with DOUBLE_DAMAGE; x1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT; x critPower only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault false, so only with ABILITY_CRIT), reduced by Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite. Not conditioned on the freeze or the paralysis.
effects.resolution: applied = requested after those multipliers; PokemonState.handleDamage then divides by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), rounds up with a minimum of 1 and lets the shield absorb first; takenDamage = shield damage + HP damage (HP part capped at current hp), 0 with protect / skydiving / magicBounce. The returned takenDamage / death is not used by this ability.

statusEffects.scaling: none from stars, AP or crit
statusEffects.resolution: Requested vs applied. Applied only if the target is not already frozen, has no rune protect, is not skydiving, has no IMMUNITY_FREEZE and its ccCooldown is 0. Applied duration = round(requested x 1.3 in snow (then x(1 - 0.2 per Icy Rock in the victim's player's items) when present) or x0.7 in drought, /2 if the target is enraged, then x0.7 SWIFT_SWIM / x0.5 HYDRATION / x0.3 WATER_VEIL or SURGE_SURFER, then x(1 - 0.1 per Odd Keystone)). Side effects when applied: an Aspear Berry holder eats it, an EISCUE_NOICE target (and EISCUE_NOICE caster) transforms to ice face. Frozen units cannot move or attack and cannot dodge; when the freeze ends, ccCooldown (1500 ms) blocks a new freeze or sleep.

statusEffects.scaling: none from stars, AP or crit (apBoost not passed, so false; origin is the caster itself)
statusEffects.resolution: Requested vs applied. Applied unless the caster has rune protect or IMMUNITY_PARALYSIS (there is no ccCooldown or already-paralysed guard; the flag is set first). Applied duration = round(requested x 1.3 in a storm (then x(1 - 0.2 per Electric Quartz in the caster's player's items)), then the water-ability and Odd Keystone reductions); the stored timer is replaced only if the new duration is longer than the remaining one. A Cheri Berry holder eats it. While paralysed the unit attack-cooldown speed is speed / 2; the flag is cleared when the timer runs out. Paralysis effects elsewhere (movement, other abilities) were not enumerated.

starBehavior.note: Only the damage is indexed by the casting entity's stars (four values; ?? 400 fallback). The listed units are catalog stars 2 and 1. Freeze and paralysis durations are fixed at 3000 ms. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: None in this strategy; range comes from the unit (1).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP. Because the freeze is rejected on an already frozen target or during its ccCooldown window, a second cast on the same target may deal damage without freezing it; the caster's paralysis timer is only extended, never shortened.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: freeze 3000 ms on the target, paralysis 3000 ms on the caster, damage 50 / 100 (1 / 2 stars). Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit / double-damage / steam multipliers, then SPE_DEF division and minimum 1; takenDamage includes shield damage. Applied freeze / paralysis durations = requested after weather, enrage (freeze only), water-ability, Odd Keystone and the item reductions listed, and only if the guards pass; the freeze can be rejected while the paralysis is still applied, and vice versa.

Crit resolution - only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate was located
Later handleDamage branches (Shiny Charm, Fossil shield, Cover Band, death handling) were not read for this record

unresolved: Passive BERRY_EATER (declared by both units) is a separate mechanism not traced here; a Cheri Berry eaten after the self-paralysis may interact with it
Other consumers of status.paralysis (movement, abilities such as Bug Buzz / Zing Zap / Force Palm that read it on targets) were not enumerated for the self-paralysis
Whether a frozen target that takes the damage is affected by any damage-triggered thaw was not traced (no thaw on damage was seen in the cited lines)
Whether the listed units ever reach a different star count than the bare factory value
